theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (r : ℝ) (g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), MeasurableSet F → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → 0 < r → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ w ∈ tsupport g, y + r • w ∈ D) → (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, inner ℝ (g (r⁻¹ • (z - y))) (ν z) ∂μ = -∫ w in (fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g w : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1))
